tasks.title: Scaffold app and validator
tasks.description: Create the dependency-free static application shell, module and asset directories, local preview server, and deterministic task-aware Node validation script.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository contains index.html, styles.css, js/app.mjs, js/store.mjs, data/skills.json, tests/serve.mjs, tests/validate.mjs, and assets/openclaw-mark.svg.
The initial HTML uses semantic landmarks and stable DOM hooks without inline event-handler attributes or remote resources.
The preview server serves repository files with safe path handling and no third-party dependency.
The validator accepts --task scaffold-and-validator, exits zero for a valid scaffold, and exits nonzero for an unknown task ID.

tasks.title: Build catalog landing page
tasks.description: Define the realistic skill catalog and render a responsive marketplace landing page with local OpenClaw branding, metadata, loading state, and reusable visual tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: data/skills.json contains at least eight schema-valid skills spanning at least four categories with unique slugs and complete detail, permission, security, command, and manifest fields.
The landing page renders each skill as a semantic card with name, author, category, summary, rating, downloads, security status, and installed-state hook.
The interface has a distinct OpenClaw identity using only local assets, CSS, and system fonts.
Loading and load-error states are clear, and the layout includes safeguards against horizontal overflow at 375px.

tasks.title: Implement catalog discovery
tasks.description: Implement deterministic search, category filtering, derived counts, result announcements, and the resettable empty state using pure functions and event listeners.
acceptanceCriteria: Search is case-insensitive and matches skill name, author, slug, and description.
Category controls combine correctly with search, expose their selected state, and show derived category and visible-result counts.
A zero-result query displays a useful empty state with a working control that resets discovery state.
Pure discovery functions are importable in Node and covered for individual and combined search/filter cases.

tasks.title: Add skill detail dialog
tasks.description: Implement URL-addressable skill details in an accessible native dialog, including complete metadata, description, permissions, security status, and SKILL.md manifest preview.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a card shows version, author, downloads, rating, update date, complete description, requested permissions, security/risk status, and the full manifest preview.
The selected skill is represented by ?skill=<slug>; refresh and browser back/forward restore or close the dialog without requiring a server rewrite.
The dialog has an accessible name, explicit close control, Escape handling, initial focus, and focus restoration to the invoking card.
Unknown or malformed skill query values recover to the catalog without an uncaught error.

tasks.title: Implement secure installation
tasks.description: Build the staged security review, permission confirmation, install-command, and completion flow with idempotent localStorage persistence and installed catalog state.
acceptanceCriteria: Installation progresses in order through security review, permission confirmation, install command, and completed state with visible current-step text.
The exact catalog install command is presented in a keyboard-accessible command region only after review and confirmation.
Completing installation persists a unique slug under the versioned localStorage key and updates both card and dialog installed states after reload.
Missing, malformed, duplicate, or unavailable localStorage data is handled without breaking catalog use.
The install dialog supports keyboard operation, Escape-to-close, accessible naming, and deterministic focus restoration.

tasks.title: Harden responsive states
tasks.description: Harden loading, error, URL, storage, empty, installed, and dialog behavior; finish narrow-screen styling and deterministic security checks across all shipped static files.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading, data-load error, empty results, selected filters, installed skills, dialogs, and completed installation each have clear textual and visual states.
Long slugs, manifests, and install commands remain contained, and layout rules prevent document-level horizontal overflow at 375px.
Fetch, history, unknown-route, and storage failures degrade to a usable catalog or actionable message without uncaught application errors.
Shipped source and content contain no remote assets, external fonts, inline event handlers, API keys, credentials, or secret-like values.

tasks.title: Complete accessible release
tasks.description: Perform the final accessibility pass, add architecture and ForgeLoop provenance content, complete usage and deployment documentation, preserve progress and automation evidence, and configure validated GitHub Pages deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Landmarks, headings, labels, live status, keyboard operation, focus visibility and restoration, Escape behavior, non-color status cues, and reduced-motion support satisfy the documented accessibility contracts.
The application contains an architecture/provenance section naming ForgeLoop and linking to a non-placeholder HTTPS GitHub repository for the autonomous system.
README.md explains dependency-free local preview, task and full validation, GitHub Pages deployment, generated provenance, routes, storage, and accessibility behavior.
progress.txt and .agent/events.jsonl provide nonempty progress and automation evidence, and the implementation history consists of task-scoped commits created only after validation.
.github/workflows/pages.yml validates the release and deploys the static artifact on main or manual dispatch with least-privilege Pages permissions and deployment concurrency.
A documented manual pass confirms the complete keyboard install flow, refreshed detail URL, persisted installed state, reduced motion, and no horizontal overflow at 375px.
